_comment: Settings for local-coder-dispatch-guard.py, the PreToolUse gate on the Agent tool (local
coding contract, decision D1). R0: every value lives here. R4 provenance on every entry.
Deleting or breaking this file disables the gate in silence (R11), as does a missing
plan_contract module or tier file: a hook whose own dependency is absent never refuses a

enabled.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17 by the operator through the local coding contract spec, decisions D1 and D6

guarded_agents.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: the agent whose dispatch must name a valid plan. local-writer is out of scope (spec D8)

plan_line_prefix.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: the line of the dispatch prompt that names the plan file, for example 'PLAN: docs/superpowers/plans/plan1.md'

plan_contract_candidates.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: tried in order, a leading ~ is the home directory (the installed junction) and a relative path is resolved from the folder holding this hook (a clone of the repository)

tiers_candidates.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: the tier table, tried in order like plan_contract_candidates

resolver_module.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: null in production, so plan_contract asks model_resolver. A path to a python file exposing resolve(role, require_role) replaces it, which is how the offline test stays independent of the machine's local models (R21)
